subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR16 - WRITE's mnemonic-name-1 is associated with a feature-name specified by the implementor (C01, CSP - DOC-A.1-190); any other mnemonic is COBOL2243. It used to bind every SPECIAL-NAMES mnemonic as a zero-line advance (kb/Work PB862). retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/ImplementorNames.cs#ImplementorNames (the pure-data implementor-name table moved to WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions so the front end's DISPLAY directive reads the same device-names as SPECIAL-NAMES (kb/Work PB807); ImplementorNameEntry stayed in the compiler as ImplementorNameEntry.cs)
